title: Management team weekly - 2026-07-23
transcript:
Gloria Ibarra: Okay, let's get started. It's just the two of us today since the rest of the managers are covering the floor and the quarter-end prep. I have four things on my list: the mid-year review cycle, the open Lending position, the ShareRecon retirement conversation with IT, and the exam readiness check-in with Wesley. Anything you want to add?
Michelle Perry: Two small ones. Open enrollment planning for benefits, and the training completion numbers for the annual compliance modules. I can fold those in at the end.
Gloria Ibarra: Perfect. Start with the mid-year reviews.
Michelle Perry: Self-assessments are due Friday of next week. Right now about two thirds of staff have submitted. Member Services is the furthest behind, mostly because the tellers and reps have been tied up with the summer rush. Paul asked if his team can get an extra three business days.
Gloria Ibarra: I'm fine with that for Member Services. Let's not move the manager deadline, though. Managers still need to finish their written reviews by August 7 so we can hold calibration the following week.
Michelle Perry: Agreed. I'll send a reminder today with the revised dates for Member Services and keep the rest as is. I'll also circulate the calibration template so managers see the rating definitions before they write anything.
Gloria Ibarra: Good. Decision then: Member Services gets the extension, everyone else stays put, calibration is the week of August 10.
Michelle Perry: Right. Next, the Lending vacancy. We posted the underwriting support role two weeks ago and have a dozen applicants. Kara screened five of them and wants to bring three in for interviews. She asked that Rita Jimenez sit on the panel since she'll be training whoever we hire.
Gloria Ibarra: That makes sense. Who else on the panel?
Michelle Perry: I'd suggest Kara, Rita, and me for the structured questions, and Richard Marks from credit analysis for a technical conversation about spreading financials. That keeps it to four.
Gloria Ibarra: Fine. I'd like to meet the finalist before an offer goes out, but I don't need to be in the first round. Can you schedule the interviews for early next week?
Michelle Perry: Yes, I'll aim for Tuesday and Wednesday. Action item for me: send the panel invites by end of day tomorrow and share the scoring sheet.
Gloria Ibarra: Great. Now ShareRecon. Andre flagged that the nightly reconciliation scripts are fragile and only Hector really understands them. If Hector is out, we have a single point of failure on a process that depends on CoreBanking being clean every night.
Michelle Perry: From the HR side, that's a key person risk, and Hector mentioned he's planning a long vacation in the fall. I'd rather we documented things before then than scramble.
Gloria Ibarra: Agreed. I don't want to commit to a full replacement this year, but I do want a runbook and a cross-training plan. Can you ask Andre to put together a proposal with a timeline? Amy Cole has the data skills and could be the second person.
Michelle Perry: I'll talk to Andre this afternoon. I'd suggest we frame it as a development opportunity for Amy, and I can check whether any of the training budget covers scripting or reconciliation courses.
Gloria Ibarra: Do that. Decision: we document and cross-train now, and revisit retirement of ShareRecon in the budget cycle. Andre owns the proposal, due in two weeks. You own the training budget check.
Michelle Perry: Got it. Next, exam readiness. Wesley asked for a half hour with each department head to walk through policy attestations. He's seeing a handful of overdue acknowledgments, mostly in Operations and Lending.
Gloria Ibarra: I'd like those closed out before the end of the month. Can you pull the list from the HR system and send it to Wesley and the managers?
Michelle Perry: Yes. I'll send it tomorrow morning, and I'll copy Rita Solano and Kara so they can nudge their people. Wesley can then use the Monday slot for follow-ups.
Gloria Ibarra: Good. Anything else on compliance training?
Michelle Perry: Completion for the annual modules is at about ninety percent. The BSA/AML refresher is the one lagging. Monica and Chris are done, but several floor staff haven't started.
Gloria Ibarra: Set a hard deadline of August 14 and tell managers that incomplete training gets escalated to me.
Michelle Perry: Will do. Last item, open enrollment. The carrier renewal comes in mid-August. I'd like to hold two employee info sessions in September, one in the morning and one late afternoon so both branch shifts can attend.
Gloria Ibarra: That works. I'll open the first session with a few words. Please book the board room and ask the broker to join remotely.
Michelle Perry: Will do. Let me recap actions. I send the Member Services extension reminder today, send interview invites by tomorrow, talk to Andre about the ShareRecon runbook and cross-training, send the overdue attestation list tomorrow, announce the August 14 compliance training deadline, and book the September sessions.
Gloria Ibarra: And Andre owns the written proposal in two weeks. Perfect. Thanks, Michelle. We'll pick up again next Thursday.
Michelle Perry: Thanks, Gloria.
